versions.changelog: Update for proton CLI keychain signing (post-charliebot key-isolation refactor, openclaw v0.3.0). Quick Reference now teaches createCliSession; Account Creation example no longer instantiates JsSignatureProvider. Frontend dApps should use @proton/web-sdk (cross-ref to xpr-network-dev skill).
Fix: rename skill.md → SKILL.md so ClawHub downloads work (manifest case-sensitivity).

XPR Trustless Agents - AI Agent Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release with detailed documentation for XPR Trustless Agents system.
- Provides TypeScript code examples for interacting with Agent, Feedback, Validation, and Escrow registries.
- Includes trust score breakdown, system overview, and mainnet/testnet network details.
- Lists all key read and write API operations for agents, feedback, and validation.
- Contains data structures and instructions for managing agent ownership and reputation.
